ImageCaptureKind: Avalonia RenderTargetBitmap of the visible native Window; not a desktop screenshot.

MeasurementDefinitions.Preparation: Key lookup, BringIntoView and native InputHitTest readiness are timed separately from input routing. Scene wait includes layout, coordinate checks and 16 ms polling; it is an observation, not an actual presented-frame timestamp.
MeasurementDefinitions.PointerRoute: After the key coordinate hits its native visual, time from raising PointerPressed to the first TextBox.TextProperty change. PointerReleased is raised synchronously for each ordinary key. Release-route timing starts immediately before PointerReleased. Neither includes key preparation or physical input delivery.
MeasurementDefinitions.Samples: Each scenario has 20 discarded warmup iterations and 100 validated recorded iterations. Text/caret/selection setup occurs before preparation; one TextProperty change and a matching TwoWay ViewModel value are required. Percentiles use linear interpolation between sorted observations.
MeasurementDefinitions.Repeat: TextProperty change timestamps begin at the prepared Backspace PointerPressed route. First repeat lateness is the gap from initial TextProperty change to the second change minus configured RepeatDelay. Subsequent intervals omit the initial-to-first-repeat gap. No scheduler catch-up or latency guarantee is inferred.
MeasurementDefinitions.Cancellation: CancelInput is called while the pointer is held. Capture state, all later TextProperty changes, text and TwoWay model stability are observed through a wait of RepeatDelay + 3 * RepeatInterval, a stale pointer release, and a further wait of 3 * RepeatInterval.
MeasurementDefinitions.Thresholds: This mode gathers a repeatable baseline and validates input/count/cancellation semantics. It sets no arbitrary performance release thresholds; compare repeated runs on the same platform, window size, font, theme and build configuration before selecting thresholds.
